name: SDB
description: x86-64 debugger implementation supporting breakpoints, stack unwinding, and source-level stepping. Built using ptrace system calls for process control and DWARF parser for reading debug information from binaries.

name: 2D Game Engine
description: Component-based game engine built from scratch featuring entity-component-system (ECS) architecture, collision detection and resolution, render layers, sprite system, generalized animation framework, and custom memory allocators. Designed for building 2D games with Lua scripting support.

name: GoCI
description: Lightweight command-line continuous integration tool for Go projects. Automates build processes, runs tests, checks code formatting, and handles git push workflows. Actively used for personal project deployment automation.

name: LeetScribe
description: Chrome extension that automatically captures LeetCode solutions and generates structured UMPIRE-format notes using AI. Syncs solutions and documentation to GitHub, helping developers maintain organized records of their problem-solving journey. Features AI-powered documentation generation, GitHub integration, and optional Notion sync.

name: StarSight
description: Full-stack stargazing prediction platform integrating real-time weather data, light pollution metrics, and astronomical databases to provide location-based visibility forecasts. Features constellation recognition using machine learning trained on 10,000+ astronomical images with 85% accuracy.

name: Studia
description: Full-stack AI-powered study assistant that generates adaptive explanations, quizzes, and flashcards. Features vector search using OpenAI embeddings to retrieve content from Wikipedia and YouTube, with multi-modal accessibility including file uploads, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech.

name: Ask Breezy
description: Conversational chatbot that queries AccuWeather API to provide location-based weather conditions using AI tool calls, enabling users to get weather information through natural language interactions.

name: Flashcard App
description: Full-stack flashcard application with user authentication, deck management, and interactive study features.

name: Portfolio Website
description: Personal portfolio website showcasing projects and skills.
